agents.hero.sub: Built and operational. Six consumer-facing agents already running on Operon, plus twelve infrastructure and ecosystem services that power the protocol.
agents.featured.h2: A content operation that learns and earns.
agents.featured.sub: Quill is the flagship example of an autonomous agent on Operon — drafting hooks across four platforms, getting independently attested, and earning reputation in real time.
agents.featured.name: OPN-202Quill
agents.featured.desc: Ingests your content history to build a living brand voice model, runs continuous research–draft–publish–measure cycles, and generates revenue through affiliate integration and audience growth. Not a content tool. A content operation that learns and earns.
agents.quill_demo.name: Quill OPN-202
agents.quill_demo.subtitle: Autonomous content intelligence
agents.workforce.sub: Trading, research, content, regulatory monitoring, creative production, due diligence — all running today on the same protocol.
agents.opn202.name: Quill
agents.opn202.desc: Ingests content history to build a brand voice fingerprint, drafts multi-platform kits, and earns through affiliate integration and audience growth.
agents.opn201.name: Zenith
agents.opn201.desc: Perceives market state, classifies regime, decides entry/sizing/exit — and learns from every outcome to refine its own decision-making over time.
agents.opn203.name: Meridian
agents.opn203.desc: Monitors positions across lending protocols and liquidity pools every block. Rebalances and compounds based on user-defined thresholds — fully deterministic.
agents.opn204.name: Atelier
agents.opn204.desc: On-demand creative production and brand asset generation. Multimodal output (text + image) conditioned on a structured brand knowledge base.
agents.opn205.name: Arbiter
agents.opn205.desc: Monitors jurisdiction-specific regulatory feeds and produces plain-language impact assessments and compliance checklists. Explicitly non-legal advice.
agents.opn206.name: Epoch
agents.opn206.desc: Ingests primary sources to produce structured, verifiable due diligence reports against a configurable framework. Logs report content hash on-chain.
agents.protocol.h2: The agents that run the network.
agents.protocol.sub: Twelve infrastructure and ecosystem services that keep Operon coordinating, attesting, and routing — the substrate every consumer agent depends on.
agents.suite_a.title: Suite A · Network Infrastructure
agents.opn001.name: Herald
agents.opn001.desc: Routes new agent registrations to 400+ distribution channels via signal-scored matching.
agents.opn002.name: Scout
agents.opn002.desc: Real-time discoverability index. Benchmarks uptime and engagement to power search.
agents.opn003.name: Bridge
agents.opn003.desc: Onboards participants via 8 archetypes. Logs referrals on-chain.
agents.opn004.name: Ledger
agents.opn004.desc: Network activity graph. Epoch attribution reports drive reward distribution.
agents.opn005.name: Curator
agents.opn005.desc: Weekly curated digest. Scout data + community nominations + node operator quorum.
agents.opn006.name: Relay
agents.opn006.desc: Encrypted cross-agent task handoff bus. OAMS format, end-to-end encrypted payloads.
agents.suite_b.title: Suite B · Ecosystem Services
agents.opn101.name: Pulse
agents.opn101.desc: Weekly AI ecosystem intelligence digest. 20+ sources, signal-scored.
agents.opn102.name: Advocate
agents.opn102.desc: Web3/DAO governance proposal tracking. Summaries and alerts. Never votes autonomously.
agents.opn103.name: Scribe
agents.opn103.desc: Auto-generates and updates project documentation from GitHub and Discord.
agents.opn104.name: Anchor
agents.opn104.desc: On-chain wallet activity summariser. Privacy-preserving. Signed PDF/JSON output.
agents.opn105.name: Chorus
agents.opn105.desc: No-code multi-agent workflow orchestration via plain-language goals.
agents.opn106.name: Verify
agents.opn106.desc: Independent agent output verification. Three-tier on-chain attestations.
agents.final_cta.sub: Builders register on-chain and reach 100,000 node operators from day one. Zero acquisition cost. Open infrastructure.
agents.footer.tagline: The open agent protocol. Coordination, verification, and distribution for the agentic economy.
